ray_scene_review.finding: Confirmed: clearing live transforms/primitives before late instance/capacity validation corrupts the state subsequently consumed by encode(), even when the caller tries to recover.
ray_scene_review.fix: Reusable candidate transform/primitive vectors; validate camera, ranges, capacity and every transform; swap into live state only on complete success. No per-frame fresh candidate allocation after capacity warmup, no new GPU resource path.
ray_scene_review.regression: Real-adapter unit test snapshots live arrays, counts, camera, pass/build counters and dirty flag for late NaN, late capacity failure, out-of-bounds/reversed/count ranges and invalid camera. Tests both built state and successful update pending encode. Invalid update never replaces that state; unchanged recovered instances produce zero AS passes.

instrument_contract.math: GPL flight-authority::navball::InstrumentFrame: f64 surface-frame orthonormal basis, body nose +X/right -Y/up +Z. Projected spin-pole north, north cross up east, heading explicitly unavailable at poles/vertical nose. Zero/invalid velocity omits prograde; rear vectors do not leak onto the visible hemisphere.
instrument_contract.data: Existing Scene::flight_data shared authority/kinematics supplies up, pole and surface velocity in the vehicle body frame. Native server instruments retain newest-replica telemetry versus interpolated world pose; no fabricated time-identity claim.
instrument_contract.render: App-owned fastnavball.rs/WGSL in the existing egui-wgpu callback/pass/device/queue. One six-vertex native-pixel quad; physical output resolution follows DPI. Changed frame/palette uploads 48 bytes, unchanged input skips upload. No CPU128 image, 30 Hz/travel throttle, per-attitude texture, scene copy/readback or intermediate scene target.
instrument_contract.representations: CPU128 legacy baseline; native analytic derivative-filtered graticules (auto/default); optional static R8 graticule with wrapped longitude and area-reduced mips. Wrapped angular derivatives avoid atan2 branch-cut AA/mip seams. Live labels, reticle, roll scale and surface prograde/retrograde/radial-up vectors reuse egui vectors/font.
instrument_contract.layouts: Aircraft blue/brown sphere with surface-speed/datum-altitude tapes and gear switch. Spacecraft black/white FDAI-inspired sphere with vertical/horizontal surface-speed decomposition, pitch/roll readouts and reaction-wheel switch. Both preserve current commands and show surface, not IAS/orbital telemetry. SIM is sample time since epoch, not a fabricated mission timer. Display changes never select a control law.
instrument_contract.settings: [instruments] enabled, quality, layout=aircraft|rocket, navball_renderer=auto|analytic|baked. Common graphics resolver/helper; disabled/no-data removes callback resources and draws/uploads nothing instrument-specific. Quality Low/Medium/High uses 192/256/320 logical points and optional 512/1024/2048-wide static atlases; native viewport is not a source-resolution cap.
instrument_contract.licensing: No KSA/Apollo code or artwork copied; original procedural display, existing OFL font. No dependency, unsafe code, new crate or GPL-to-MIT move. Legacy Bevy instrument unchanged.

legacy_CPU128.boundary: Pixel generation only; not upload/draw. Does not contain heading/marker feature parity with the new path.

initial_release_representation_diagnosti.boundary: Hardware GPU command intervals bracket clear+quad only, excluding labels/markers/egui/scene; host includes update+submit+completion but excludes timestamp readback. Different output sizes and analytic-versus-baked line filtering are not image-identical workloads. Pipeline/cache/clocks uncontrolled. Initial run precedes the wrapped-longitude-derivative fix; do not present it as the final shader's exact timing.
initial_release_representation_diagnosti.decision: Auto selects analytic: baking did not consistently win both extents and adds preparation/storage. No CPU/GPU end-to-end speedup ratio, whole-renderer win or game FPS claim.

final_isolated_representation_diagnostic.boundary: Final wrapped-derivative/pole-safe shader. Separate sequential GPU job after other agent GPU checks. Same clear+quad boundary as initial diagnostic, no labels/markers/egui in these GPU intervals. CPU128 is generation only and not a feature-/resolution-matched baseline. No end-to-end CPU/GPU speedup ratio. Clocks/caches not controlled; changed input uploads 48 bytes, paused unchanged input skips upload; baked High retains 2796203 static R8 mip bytes.

final_native_controls.shared: Sequential silent 1280x720 local --flight --chase --hud, 120 samples after 30 warmup and 10 s prestream; same RT-off/shadows-disabled configs as initial controls. Final packed terrain encoder and gpu_scope_layout=unified-scene-v2. All four exited 0.
final_native_controls.authority_identity: All end at presentation time 2.5 s and body inertial position [4821999341525.126,110259115.18622804,192817.30653965616]. These still include asynchronous streaming and other UI work, not an isolated FPS comparison.
